# Amari Method

> Chronic pain relief in San Francisco. Garrett Hewstan teaches practice members to address their own pain through 8 core rebalancing protocols — no drugs, no surgery, no ongoing dependency.

## What It Is

The Amari Method is a somatic movement education practice based in San Francisco. It works on the principle that chronic pain is caused by imbalance — something is working too hard because something else isn't working enough. Garrett finds the imbalance, then teaches the practice member 8 core protocols using simple props (yoga blocks, foam rollers, gymnastic rings) that correct it. Most practice members feel relief in their first session.

## Who Does It

**Garrett Hewstan** — Creator of the Amari Method. 25+ years working with the body. Certified Massage Therapist (CMT). He sees practice members in-person in San Francisco and virtually worldwide.

## Who It's For

Adults with chronic musculoskeletal pain who haven't found lasting relief through other approaches. Common conditions: lower back pain, neck pain, shoulder pain, hip pain, knee pain, sciatica, TMJ, plantar fasciitis, chronic pain.

## Ways to begin

- **Amari Assessment** — 50 minutes, $29. A focused assessment and clear next-step recommendation.
- **6-Week Amari Practice** — $3,000. 12 guided in-person practice visits with Living Practice access.
- **12-Week Amari Practice** — $5,400. 24 guided in-person practice visits with Living Practice access.

In-person: San Francisco, CA. Virtual: available worldwide.
